info.description: Aligned to ASMO AI Search API Specification v2.0: POST /v1/search (multipart/form-data) and GET /v1/search/suggestions. Response and filter keys are the OpenSearch index field names. Set the category_id variable to a real category id from the index.

request.description: language=ar is accepted by the contract; the index has no Arabic fields, so the backend searches the German (_de) fields.
